# Where to Watch FOREVER MY GIRL


by Angel | November 19, 2026


Country music superstar Liam Page walked away from his bride at the altar to chase fame and fortune. Years later, he returns to his small hometown and comes face to face with the love he never forgot—and the life he never knew he could have.


Starring Alex Roe and Jessica Rothe, *Forever My Girl* is a heartfelt romantic drama about love, family, forgiveness, and the chance to make things right. With Southern charm, country music, and an emotional story of second chances, it’s a romance worth settling in for.


[Watch Forever My Girl now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/forever-my-girl)


### **A Love Story That Never Really Ended**


Liam Page had a promising future in country music, but pursuing his dreams meant leaving his hometown—and Josie, the woman he was supposed to marry. When he walked away from their wedding, he chose fame over the life they had planned together.


But time and success haven’t erased his feelings for Josie. When Liam unexpectedly returns home, he has to face the heartbreak he left behind that their story isn’t over.


### **The Meaning of Family and Second Chances**


Coming home also brings Liam face to face with the consequences of his choices. The people he left behind have built lives of their own, and he can’t simply pick up where he left off.


As he reconnects with Josie and his hometown, Liam begins to understand that love means more than saying the right things. It takes humility, forgiveness, and a willingness to show up for the people who matter.


### **Watch** ***Forever My Girl*** **on Angel**


Can Liam make things right with the woman he left behind and discover what he’s been missing all these years?


Find out in *Forever My Girl* , a romantic story about coming home, rediscovering love, and getting another chance at the life you thought you’d lost.
